config.translatorpp.chat_translation.too:
Hover Key: chat is translated only while you hold the translate key over a message.
Automatic: messages not in your target language are replaced by their translation as they arrive. Hover the text to see the original. The hover key still works everywhere.
config.translatorpp.azure_key.tooltip: Your own key from an Azure Translator resource. Stored unencrypted in config/translatorpp.toml, so keep that file private.
config.translatorpp.azure_region.tooltip: The region of your Azure resource, such as westus2. Leave empty for a global resource.
config.translatorpp.japanese_servers.too: Server addresses, separated by commas. On these servers all chat is sent as Japanese without detection, and Latin text is read as romaji. English messages there will come out wrong. Subdomains match too: example.net covers play.example.net.
config.translatorpp.yomitan_manage: Import, order and enable dictionaries with the %s key.
config.translatorpp.yomitan_source.toolt:
Built-in Dictionaries: answered inside the game from dictionaries you import.
Yomitan in Browser: answered by the Yomitan extension through yomitan-api, which needs the browser running.
